Job Description - Manager, Field Environmental (000HC3)

Job Description 

Manager, Field Environmental-000HC3

Description

 

The Field Environmental Manager leads a team of environmental professionals responsible for maintaining environmental compliance across assigned assets and operations. This role partners closely with Operations leadership and other internal stakeholders to ensure compliance with applicable environmental regulations, permits, and company policies. Other responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead environmental management systems at facilities throughout the region to ensure compliance with environmental air, water, and waste regulations, permits, programs, procedures, and policies.

  • Stay informed of environmental matters within the region and prioritize them in a timely, efficient, and effective manner.

  • Provide leadership, assistance, and guidance to their team of environmental professionals as well as provide timely feedback.

Qualifications

 

The successful candidate will meet the following qualifications:

  • Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, or a related field is required. 

  • Minimum of ten (10) years of environmental compliance experience within the oil and gas industry.

  • Working knowledge of federal and state environmental regulations applicable to oil and gas operations preferably in Texas and other mid-continent states.

Preferred Qualifications
